description: Quick setup cards on the teacher's New event form. Each preset is a question filter (the same shape as an event filter) plus the coarse knobs a teacher may turn on it: who (audience and level), emphasis (Brennan & Resnick dimension) and length (short or full). Validated at boot by src/content.js.

presets.label: Core CT check (P5 to S2)
presets.description: Bebras-style puzzles on sequences, patterns, logic, paths and data. No coding needed.

presets.label: RGSynapse Sec 1 starter
presets.description: Gentler Sec 1 questions (difficulty 1 to 2): reading code, events, remixing and checking AI answers.

presets.label: RGSynapse Sec 2
presets.description: The full Sec 2 set: tracing, translating, parallelism, iterating with AI and reviewing its code.

presets.label: Debugging and AI-code review
presets.description: Find the bug, spot the missing edge case, question what an AI wrote. Includes written answers marked by AI.

presets.label: Loops and conditionals
presets.description: Repetition and decisions: predict what a loop does, follow an if, combine conditions.

presets.label: Code ordering and tracing practice
presets.description: Put lines of code in order (Parsons) and type the exact output of a program.

presets.label: Mixed: everything for a level
presets.description: Every question for one level, all types except AI-scored ones.
